Metadata.Data Owner: Chicago Police Department Bureau of Internal Affairs

columns.name: LOG_NO
columns.description: A unique identifier for the case record. The log number can be used to link records in other datasets that contain a log number column.

columns.name: COMPLAINT_DATE
columns.description: The date the complaint or notification was made to BIA and the record was created.

columns.name: CASE_TYPE
columns.description: Whether a case is a complaint, a notification, or miscellaneous.

columns.name: CURRENT_STATUS
columns.description: The current status of the case investigation, as of the date the data were last published.

columns.name: ADMINISTRATIVE_SUMMARY_REPORT
columns.description: Link to the Administrative Summary Report (ASR) which is an electronic record that provides an abstract of the complaint investigation after a final disciplinary decision is reached.

columns.name: FINAL_CATEGORY
columns.description: Complaints are placed into categories. The investigating Sergeant determines the final category.

columns.name: FINDING_CODE
columns.description: The overall current case finding, ranked by the following hierarchy: Sustained, Not Sustained, Unfounded, Exonerated, No Affidavit, and No Finding.“Current_Finding” means even after BIA has completed an investigation and made a recommended finding, the finding can change given post-BIA processes, including Police Department review, Police Board adjudication, and grievance and arbitration processes.

columns.name: BEAT
columns.description: The CPD beat in which the incident occurred. If more than one beat was involved, the values are separated by the pipe (|) character.

columns.name: RACE_OF_INVOLVED_OFFICER
columns.description: The race or ethnicity of the officer alleged to have been involved.

columns.name: SEX_OF_INVOLVED_OFFICER
columns.description: The sex of the officer alleged to have been involved.

columns.name: AGE_OF_INVOLVED_OFFICER
columns.description: The age of the officer alleged to have been involved, at the time of the complaint or notification.

columns.name: YEARS_ON_FORCE_OF_INVOLVED_OFFICER
columns.description: The number of years on the force of the officer alleged to have been involved, at the time of the complaint or notification.

columns.name: COMPLAINT_HOUR
columns.description: The hour of the day component of COMPLAINT_DATE.

columns.name: COMPLAINT_DAY
columns.description: The day of the week component of COMPLAINT_DATE. Sunday=1
